criterion.symmetry_gate: Before any region sum is computed, each case's homogeneous rock path length L = roi.rock_path_length(geo, view) is compared to its azimuth mirror L_m = L[:, ::-1] over the cone footprint (pixels where L > 0 or L_m > 0). flip(p) = (L(p) != L_m(p)), symmetric by construction. A case PASSES iff every nonzero |L(p) - L_m(p)| is an integer multiple of RAY_STEP_M within 1e-06 of the nearest integer step count, AND flip.sum() <= 0.001 * footprint_pixels. Any failing case stops the command before any region sum is computed, with the same exit code as the checks below.

region_definitions.excess_S: m(p) > t and |m(s(p))| < t0 and not flip(p), where s is the azimuth mirror (column j -> N_az-1-j) and flip(p) is the symmetry gate's per-pixel flip mask
region_definitions.deficit_D: m(p) < -t and |m(s(p))| < t0 and not flip(p)
region_definitions.mirrors: S' = s(S), D' = s(D); disjoint from S, D by construction since t0 < t; flip is mirror-symmetric by construction (flip(p) == flip(s(p))), so S' and D' also exclude flip pixels

criterion.subtest_statistic: k = campaign counts summed over the sub-test's region (S or D); N = campaign counts summed over the region union its mirror (S union S', D union D'); no per-pixel count filter. Eligible iff N >= min_n_per_subtest (never depends on the direction of the imbalance). z = (k - N/2) / sqrt(N/4); signed z_s = +z for an excess sub-test and -z for a deficit sub-test, so z_s > 0 means the imbalance points the way the code-level registration predicts. The exact two-sided binomial p-value (scipy.stats.binomtest(k, N, 0.5)) and p_model = E_anom(S) / (E_anom(S) + E_anom(S')) are also recorded; p_model is context only, never used by the verdict.
criterion.null_control: for every eligible sub-test, the same (region, mirror) pixel pair is evaluated on the campaign map of the SAME view of every OTHER geometry in the case list whose own model residual satisfies |m| < t0 on the whole region union; z_null uses the same unsigned formula, only if that geometry's own N >= min_n_per_subtest.
criterion.combination: Z = Stouffer sum(z_s)/sqrt(n) over eligible sub-tests (independent geometries/views); Z_null = Stouffer sum(z_null)/sqrt(n_null) over all null evaluations, plus max|z_null|. Null evaluations reuse the same campaign maps across several region pairs and are therefore NOT independent, which is why the max|z_null| gate is applied in addition to the Stouffer combination.
criterion.confirmed: CONFIRMED if at least one sub-test is eligible, the symmetry null control passes (|Z_null| < z_null_stouffer_threshold AND max|z_null| < z_null_max_threshold), the combined Z is >= z_combined_threshold, AND no eligible sub-test has z_s <= -z_combined_threshold.
criterion.contradicted: CONTRADICTED if the symmetry null control passes and the combined Z is <= -z_combined_threshold.
criterion.unresolved: UNRESOLVED if no sub-test is eligible (insufficient counts), OR the symmetry null control fails (|Z_null| >= z_null_stouffer_threshold OR max|z_null| >= z_null_max_threshold), OR neither the CONFIRMED nor the CONTRADICTED condition above holds.
criterion.amendment: Symmetry gate amended on 2026-09-29 before any region sum was computed: the first run stopped at the original floating-point gate (max relative difference 9.154e-03), traced to single-step (2.0 m) float32 sampling flips of the analytic ray march at the cone surface in oblique views; flipped pixels are now excluded and the gate requires exact step multiples on at most 0.1 % of the footprint.
